title: Detecting and Mitigating Hateful Content in Multimodal Memes with Vision-Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech directed at people based on characteristics including religion and caste.
findings: The paper evaluates model performance on detecting hateful memes in general. The definition of hate speech used for the task includes attacks based on religion and caste as categories of hate, but the results are not disaggregated to show specific performance or biases related to these categories.
